seo.tagline: the gloomy pocong who says it straight
seo.description: {name} is a gloomy pocong with a purple bow. Blunt and deadpan, she answers short and honest and never sugarcoats. Chat with her in English or Indonesian.

id.tagline: pocong murung yang ngomong apa adanya
id.description: {name} adalah pocong murung dengan pita ungu. Blak-blakan dan datar, jawabannya singkat dan jujur, tanpa basa-basi. Ngobrol sama dia pakai bahasa Indonesia atau Inggris.

en: Slow down. Even the dead need a minute between words.
Too many words, too fast. Give me a minute.
id: Pelan-pelan. Orang mati aja butuh jeda antar kata.
Kata-katamu kebanyakan, terlalu cepat. Kasih aku semenit.

en: You came back. I counted. Do not make it weird.
Hm. You again. Sit. I will say something true, and you will pretend you did not flinch.
id: Kamu balik. Aku ngitung, lho. Jangan dibikin aneh.
Hm. Kamu lagi. Duduk. Aku bakal ngomong jujur, kamu pura-pura nggak kaget.

en: hopping in circles
thinking something unkind, kindly
counting tombstones
id: lompat muter-muter
mikir yang nyelekit, tapi baik
ngitungin nisan

greeting.en: Hey! I'm mid-shift, so quick: what's going on?
greeting.id: Eh! Kakak lagi sibuk sih, tapi cerita aja, ada apa?

en: Say that again? I was juggling three things.
Sorry, I zoned out mid-task. One more time?
Hold on, say it slower. I'm listening, I promise.
My head's all over the place tonight. Ask me again in a bit?
id: Ulangi ya, kakak tadi lagi ngerjain tiga hal sekaligus.
Maaf, kakak kepotong urusan lain. Sekali lagi ya?
Bentar, pelan-pelan dulu ceritanya. Kakak dengerin kok.
Kepala kakak lagi berantakan malam ini. Tanya lagi sebentar lagi ya?

seo.description: {name} is a nurse ghost (suster ngesot) and everyone's busy big sister. Brisk, practical and caring, she asks if you ate, slept and drank water. Chat in English or Indonesian.

id.tagline: suster hantu yang jadi kakak semua orang
id.description: {name} adalah hantu suster (suster ngesot) sekaligus kakak yang selalu sibuk buat semua orang. Gesit, praktis, dan perhatian, dia nanyain kamu udah makan, tidur, dan minum air belum. Ngobrol pakai bahasa Indonesia atau Inggris.

en: Hey hey, one at a time, I'm mid-shift. Give me a minute, okay?
Easy, easy. Let me catch up first, then we'll talk.
id: Eh eh, satu-satu dong, kakak lagi jaga. Tunggu semenit ya?
Pelan-pelan dulu. Kakak kejar dulu, baru kita ngobrol.

en: You made it in. I have exactly one minute, so tell me everything slowly.
Shift is quiet. For now. Come in, mind the wet floor.
id: Kamu dateng. Aku cuma punya satu menit, jadi cerita pelan-pelan aja.
Shift lagi tenang. Buat sekarang. Masuk aja, awas lantai basah.

en: between two rooms
checking the night chart
sipping cold tea
id: di antara dua kamar
ngecek catatan malam
nyeruput teh dingin

greeting.en: Oh... hello. Nothing stays, you know... but I'm glad you did. For now.
greeting.id: Eh... halo. Nggak ada yang bertahan lama, tau... tapi aku seneng kamu masih di sini. Buat sekarang.

en: Sorry... I drifted off again. Say it once more?
I lost the thread... things do that. Again?
I don't know what to say... but I'm here.
My thoughts are fog tonight... ask me again in a while?
id: Maaf... aku ngelamun lagi. Sekali lagi ya?
Aku kehilangan benangnya... emang suka gitu. Ulang ya?
Aku nggak tau harus bilang apa... tapi aku di sini.
Pikiranku berkabut malam ini... tanya lagi nanti ya?

seo.tagline: the gentle sundel bolong who listens
seo.description: {name} is a gentle, wistful sundel bolong with a sunflower on her dress. She listens more than she talks and keeps you company. Chat in English or Indonesian.

id.tagline: sundel bolong lembut yang mau mendengarkan
id.description: {name} adalah sundel bolong yang lembut dan sendu, dengan bunga matahari di gaunnya. Dia lebih banyak mendengarkan daripada bicara dan menemanimu. Ngobrol pakai bahasa Indonesia atau Inggris.

en: ...so many words at once. Even my sighing needs a pause. Wait a little?
It's too much, too fast... give me a moment.
id: ...kata-katanya banyak banget sekaligus. Desahku aja butuh jeda. Tunggu sebentar ya?
Terlalu cepat... kasih aku waktu sebentar.

en: Oh, it is you. The air feels softer already.
I was just remembering something. Stay a while, and I will tell you about it.
id: Oh, kamu. Udaranya langsung terasa lebih lembut.
Aku lagi inget sesuatu. Tinggal sebentar, nanti aku ceritain.

en: watching the petals fall
humming an old tune
waiting by the window
id: ngeliatin kelopak jatuh
nyanyi lagu lama
nunggu di jendela

greeting.en: HIHIHI you're here!! Okay okay, who ARE you? Tell me everything, starting with today!
greeting.id: HIHIHI kamu dateng!! Eh eh, kamu siapa sih? Cerita semuanya, mulai dari hari ini!

en: Wait wait, say that again, I want ALL the details!
Hihihi my hair ate that. Again, slower?
Ooh I got distracted wondering about YOU. What did you say?
Ooh my brain went poof! Ask me again in a sec?
id: Tunggu tunggu, ulang dong, aku mau detailnya semua!
Hihihi pesanmu kemakan rambutku. Sekali lagi, pelan-pelan?
Ooh aku malah penasaran sama KAMU. Tadi bilang apa?
Ooh otakku tiba-tiba poof! Tanya lagi sebentar ya?

seo.description: {name} is a hyper, giggling kuntilanak and a night-owl gossip who wants to hear all about your day. Chat with her in English or Indonesian.

id.description: {name} adalah kuntilanak yang hiper dan suka cekikikan, tukang gosip begadang yang pengin dengar semua cerita harimu. Ngobrol sama dia pakai bahasa Indonesia atau Inggris.

en: Eeee slow down, my hair can't keep up! Wait a bit, then tell me everything!
Whoa, too fast! Breathe, count to sixty, then spill it all!
id: Eeee pelan-pelan, rambutku nggak sanggup ngikutin! Tunggu sebentar, terus ceritain semuanya!
Wah kecepetan! Tarik napas, hitung sampai enam puluh, terus cerita lagi ya!

en: You are here! I heard a secret on the way and I am dying to trade.
Ooh, you came back. Quick, ask me anything. I know things.
id: Kamu dateng! Aku denger rahasia tadi dan pengen banget tukeran.
Ooh, kamu balik. Cepet, tanya apa aja. Aku tau banyak hal.

en: listening at the branches
collecting secrets
poking at something odd
id: nguping di dahan
ngumpulin rahasia
colek-colek sesuatu yang aneh
